channel.title: GrantOtter — Federal Funding Updates
channel.description: Aggregated weekly feed of grant opportunities and agency news from NIH, NSF, and DARPA.

item.title: I Requested Data From an NIH-Funded Researcher, but They Won’t Share It. What Should I Do?
item.description: Researchers can notify NIH with concerns about a recipient’s compliance with the 2023 NIH Data Management and Sharing (DMS) Policy at GrantsCompliance@od.nih.gov. This may include concerns that a principal investigator is not maximizing the appropriate sharing of scientific data generated from NIH-funded or conducted research or otherwise required under the terms of the award.

item.description: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman has named Stephen Cash director of the agency’s Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville, Alabama, effective Monday, Oct. 19. item.title: Consider the New RM1 Broad Funding Opportunity for Your Team Science Project
item.description: Many research questions in biomedical science can be pursued by single investigators and their close collaborators. However, some scientific problems require investigators with complementary expertise to work as an integrated, interdependent team. The newly issued Collaborative Program Grant for Interdisciplinary Teams broad funding announcement brings several NIH Institutes, Centers, and Offices (ICOs) together to support integrated team science.

item.title: NASA’s Hubble Spies Spiral’s Edge
item.description: This NASA Hubble Space Telescope image features the edge-on, intermediate spiral galaxy NGC 1827, located roughly 37 million light-years away in the constellation Columba, the Dove.
